name: bawaba-docs-pdf
description: Builds the Bawaba design PDFs (visual overview + full reference) from docs/

scripts.overview: mkdir -p ../../docs/pdf && python3 overview/build.py && node render-overview.mjs overview/overview.html ../../docs/pdf/Bawaba-Visual-Overview.pdf
scripts.reference: mkdir -p ../../docs/pdf && node render-full.mjs --out ../../docs/pdf/Bawaba-Design-Reference.pdf --title Bawaba --subtitle "Secure gateway for the Shamel Pro API" --version "0.2 (reviewed draft)" --date 2026-11-03 ../../docs/design/README.md ../../docs/design/00-decisions.md ../../docs/design/01-architecture.md ../../docs/design/02-security.md ../../docs/design/03-api.md ../../docs/design/04-permissions-and-tokens.md ../../docs/design/05-operations.md ../../docs/design/07-milestones.md ../../docs/design/08-isco-questions.md ../../docs/upstream/shamel-api.md
scripts.build: npm run overview && npm run reference && npm run scope
